permsText.Perception.Manage.All: Allows the app to read Agentic Security resources, create sessions and request cancellation on behalf of the signed-in user, subject to the user's access.
permsText.Perception.Read.All: Allows the app to read Agentic Security playbook definitions, sessions, agent runs, inputs, outputs and messages on behalf of the signed-in user, subject to the user's access.
permsText.RoleManagement-Authorization.Read.All: Allows the app to read unified role definitions, multi-scope role assignments, and their resource scopes, without a signed-in user.
permsText.RoleManagement-Authorization.ReadWrite.A: Allows the app to create, read, update, and delete unified role definitions; create, read, and delete multi-scope role assignments; and create, read, update, and delete their resource scopes, without a signed-in user.
